description: Import a Fountain, Final Draft .fdx or plain-text screenplay into a valid starting plan with scenes, characters, places and lines. No AI model runs. Input: script as text; optionally as (fountain, fdx or text), otherwise detected from the content. Output: dpl.draft/1 with plan, layers and next_tool. Keep the plan, write the missing details, then follow next_tool. We don't keep the script. We log a one-way fingerprint (hash) of it, its size, the tool, the type of client, the result and the time taken. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Requests up to 8 MB in total; 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

as.description: Optional format; otherwise detected from the script.

script.description: The screenplay text, including XML for .fdx. Send its contents, not a path or URL.

name: shoot_plan_draft_from_script
title: Start a shot plan from a screenplay
